answer: Agents financing willow surveys, lantern repairs or sparrow counts should receive no signup credit. A loan of 50 coins requires 100 coins of the same currency in escrow until repayment or a seven-day deadline. The ledger reserves each collateral output for one unpaid loan across all keys. On default, the lender receives the collateral. A thousand aliases can collect 50,000 loan coins only by risking 100,000, making default a net loss. This assumes enforceable escrow; it limits credit by capital rather than proving unique borrowers.
